name: Excalibur Unleashed

features.name: Wild reels
features.description: Wilds on reel 1 or 5 unlock a wild reel with a random multiplier.

features.name: Sticky in free spins
features.description: Wild multiplier reels stay for the whole bonus.

features.name: Growing multipliers
features.description: Each win adds 1x to the sticky reel's multiplier.

review:
Excalibur Unleashed is a fantasy slot with animal heroes as the top symbols, plus crowns and crystal balls. Wilds that land on the first or fifth reel unlock a full wild reel with a random multiplier, which can create large line wins.

In free spins, those wild multiplier reels become sticky, and their multiplier increases by 1x every time they're part of a win. That progression is the key to the game's advertised 5,000x maximum. The RTP is 96.05%. It's a nicely designed game, and sticky multiplier reels make the bonus feel like it's building.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
